requirements: Account required — magic link or email+password signup at /businesses/add
Fields: product name, tagline, website, location, description, industry (long LinkedIn-style list), optional square logo under 1MB
Listing goes live immediately after step 1 ('Business added successfully') — free

Step 2 'Launch Plan' offers only Premium Launch $39 (marked down from $99): launch scheduling, newsletter feature to ~13k subscribers, guest post with permanent backlink — optional, capped at 5 spots/week
preparation: Product name, tagline, website URL, location, description
workflow: Go to https://businesshunt.co/businesses/add and sign up (magic link or email+password)
Fill product info step (name, tagline, website, location, description, industry, logo)
Press Next — 'Business added successfully' means the /businesses/<slug> page is live
On step 2, decline the preselected $39 Premium Launch unless you want the launch event
Verify under 'Businesses You Manage' in the dashboard
watchFor: Step 2 presents Premium $39 preselected with no free alternative shown on that step — easy to mistake for required; the listing itself is already free and live
Homepage didn't render to our fetcher (empty body) — SPA; verify interactively
Top-3 daily spotlight badges + newsletter features are competitive
Listing links appear dofollow (noopener noreferrer, no nofollow) per third-party inspection
countsAsLive: The business has a public page under businesshunt.co/businesses/ with a 'Visit Website' button and shows in 'Businesses You Manage'
unknowns: Whether free listings get any promotion without the $39 launch
Editorial review — is anything rejected post-publish
